artifacts.angle: Explain how tap-to-pay, Apple Pay, and saved credit card info remove the neurological 'pain of paying' registered in the insula area of the brain. MIT studies showed participants spent up to 100% more when using cards over physical cash. Counter-move: turn off autofill credit cards and force manual entry for digital purchases.
artifacts.hook: Tapping your phone to pay isn't just convenient—it tricking your brain into spending 23% more on every trip.
